clue.text: A pictorial club maybe for a game of cards

parts.note: clubs (like spades) are a black suit, so a club is an example of black
a jack is a picture card, so a pictorial card is the jack

explanation.surface: A painted cudgel offered as a prize in a card game.
explanation.walkthrough: A blackjack is also a cosh, so 'club' first reads as a weapon; here it is the suit, an example of a black one.
explanation.definitionFit: Blackjack, also called pontoon or vingt-et-un, is a card game where players aim for twenty-one.
